story: After defeating his brother in 1264, Kublai ruled mainly from China rather than the Mongolian steppe. He used Chinese advisers such as Liu Bingzhong, set up Chinese-style ministries and moved his main capital to the site of the old Jin capital, Zhongdu.

In 1271 he issued an edict giving his state the dynastic name Da Yuan, the 'Great Origin', taken from the Book of Changes. It was the first time a dynastic name came from a classic rather than a place. Next to the ruins of Zhongdu he built a new planned city, Dadu, with straight streets, palaces around a lake and a canal port. In summer the court moved to Shangdu on the grasslands.
story_zh: 1264年打败弟弟之后，忽必烈主要在中原而不是蒙古草原上统治。他任用刘秉忠等汉人谋士，设立中原式的官署，还把主要都城迁到金中都旧址一带。
1271年，他下诏定国号为"大元"，取自《易经》，这是第一次用经典中的词语而不是地名作国号。他在中都旧城旁边新建了规划整齐的大都城：街道笔直，宫殿环绕湖泊，城内还有运河码头。每到夏天，朝廷就移驻草原上的上都。
kublai.why: The Yuan was the first dynasty founded by a non-Han people to rule all of China, and Dadu laid the plan of later Beijing.
kublai.why_zh: 元朝是第一个由非汉族建立并统治全中国的王朝，大都城也奠定了后来北京城的格局。

quote.zh: 可建国号曰大元，盖取《易经》“乾元”之义。
quote.en: The state shall be named Da Yuan, taking the meaning of 'Qian Yuan' from the Book of Changes.
quote.from: Edict on the dynastic name, History of Yuan 元史·建国号诏

story: Xiangyang and its twin city Fancheng sat on either side of the Han River and guarded the route into the middle Yangtze. In 1268 Yuan armies under Aju and the Song defector Liu Zheng surrounded both cities and built a fleet to cut them off by water.

The Song commander Lü Wenhuan held out for years. A relief force under Zhang Shun and Zhang Gui broke through with supplies in 1272, but both leaders died. The Yuan then brought in two engineers from the Ilkhanate in Persia, Ismail and Alaaddin, who built huge counterweight trebuchets. Their stones smashed the walls of Fancheng, which fell in early 1273. A few weeks later Lü Wenhuan surrendered Xiangyang.
story_zh: 襄阳和樊城隔汉水相望，扼守着通往长江中游的要道。1268年，元将阿术和南宋降将刘整率军包围两城，并建造水军切断水路。
南宋守将吕文焕坚守多年。1272年，张顺、张贵率援军冲破封锁送来物资，但两人都战死了。元朝随后从波斯的伊利汗国请来工匠亦思马因和阿老瓦丁，造出巨大的配重式投石机，即"回回炮"。巨石砸开了樊城城墙，樊城在1273年初陷落。几周后，吕文焕献襄阳投降。
xiangyang.why: With Xiangyang gone, the road down the Yangtze to Lin'an lay open, and the Song fell within three years.
xiangyang.why_zh: 襄阳失守后，沿长江东下直取临安的道路已经打开，三年后南宋便告灭亡。

story: Kublai sent letters to Japan from 1266 asking the Japanese to enter into relations with him, but the Kamakura shogunate did not answer. In late 1274 a fleet of about 900 ships carrying Mongol, Chinese and Korean soldiers sailed from Korea. They took the islands of Tsushima and Iki and then landed at Hakata Bay in northern Kyushu.

The invaders used tight formations, poisoned arrows and exploding bombs, which shocked the Japanese samurai who were used to fighting one-on-one. After a day of hard fighting the Yuan forces went back to their ships. That night or soon after, a storm struck the fleet as it withdrew, and many ships were lost. Historians still debate whether the storm or other reasons ended the attack.
story_zh: 从1266年起，忽必烈多次致书日本，要求通好，镰仓幕府一直不予理睬。1274年底，一支约九百艘船的舰队载着蒙古、汉人和高丽士兵从高丽出发，先攻占对马岛和壹岐岛，随后在九州北部的博多湾登陆。
元军以密集阵形作战，使用毒箭和会爆炸的"铁炮"，让习惯单挑的日本武士大为震惊。激战一天后，元军撤回船上。当夜或此后不久，撤退中的船队遭遇风暴，损失了大批船只。至于元军撤退究竟是因为风暴还是另有原因，史学家至今仍有争论。
bunei-invasion.why: The attack warned Japan to fortify Hakata Bay, which helped it defeat the much larger second invasion of 1281.
bunei-invasion.why_zh: 这次进攻让日本开始在博多湾修筑防御工事，这对它击退1281年规模更大的第二次进攻起了作用。

story: Marco Polo left Venice in 1271 with his father Niccolò and uncle Maffeo, merchants who had already visited Kublai's court. After a long journey across Persia and Central Asia, they reached Kublai at his summer capital Shangdu, probably in 1275.

According to his book, Marco stayed in China for about seventeen years and was sent on missions for the Khan. He described paper money, coal, the postal relay system and the great city of Hangzhou. The Polos finally left around 1291, escorting a Mongol princess by sea to Persia. Back in Venice, Marco was captured in a war with Genoa and dictated his story to a fellow prisoner, the writer Rustichello da Pisa.
story_zh: 1271年，马可·波罗跟随父亲尼科洛和叔叔马费奥离开威尼斯。父辈二人是商人，此前已经到过忽必烈的宫廷。他们穿越波斯和中亚，长途跋涉，大约在1275年到达忽必烈的夏都上都。
据他的书中所说，马可·波罗在中国住了大约十七年，曾奉大汗之命出使各地。他描述了纸币、煤炭、驿站制度和繁华的杭州城。大约1291年，波罗一家护送一位蒙古公主从海路前往波斯，才得以离开中国。回到威尼斯后，马可在与热那亚的战争中被俘，在狱中向同狱的作家鲁斯蒂谦口述了这段经历。
marco-polo.why: His book inspired later explorers, including Columbus. Some historians doubt parts of his story, but most accept that he really was in China.
marco-polo.why_zh: 这本书激励了包括哥伦布在内的后世探险家。有些历史学家怀疑书中部分内容，但多数人认为他确实到过中国。

story: After Xiangyang fell in 1273, Kublai put the general Bayan in command of a great army that sailed down the Han River and the Yangtze. The Song chief minister Jia Sidao led a large force against him in 1275 and was routed at Dingjiazhou. Cities along the river surrendered one after another.

Early in 1276 Bayan's army reached Lin'an. The emperor, Gong, was a child of five, and the court was run by his grandmother, Grand Empress Dowager Xie. Wen Tianxiang went to negotiate but was detained. The court handed over the imperial seal and surrendered the city without a battle. The boy emperor and the empress dowager were taken north to Kublai at Shangdu. Bayan kept order, and the city was spared.
story_zh: 1273年襄阳失守后，忽必烈任命伯颜为统帅，率大军沿汉水和长江顺流而下。1275年，南宋权相贾似道亲率大军迎战，在丁家洲一败涂地。沿江城池纷纷投降。
1276年初，伯颜大军逼近临安。当时宋恭帝只有五岁，由祖母谢太皇太后主持朝政。文天祥前往元营谈判，却被扣留。南宋朝廷交出传国玉玺，开城投降，没有经过战斗。小皇帝和太后被押往上都见忽必烈。伯颜下令约束军纪，临安城得以保全。
linan-falls.why: The surrender of the capital ended the Song state in practice, though loyalists fought on in the south for three more years.
linan-falls.why_zh: 临安投降后，南宋政权实际上已经灭亡，但忠于宋室的军民又在南方坚持抵抗了三年。

story: After Lin'an fell in 1276, loyal officials carried two young princes south and kept up the fight along the coast of Fujian and Guangdong. The elder boy died in 1278, and his younger brother Zhao Bing, aged about seven, was made emperor. The court settled at Yamen, an island anchorage at the mouth of the Pearl River delta.

The commander Zhang Shijie chained more than a thousand ships together into a floating fortress. In early 1279 the Yuan fleet under Zhang Hongfan cut off the Song ships from fresh water and then attacked. When defeat was certain, the chief minister Lu Xiufu took the boy emperor on his back and jumped into the sea. Many officials and soldiers followed them into the water.
story_zh: 1276年临安失守后，忠于宋室的大臣护着两位年幼的皇子南逃，在福建、广东沿海继续抗元。1278年哥哥病死，年仅七八岁的弟弟赵昺被立为皇帝。流亡朝廷最后驻扎在珠江口的崖山。
张世杰把一千多艘战船用铁索连在一起，结成水上营寨。1279年初，元将张弘范率水军切断宋军的淡水供应，随后发动总攻。眼看大势已去，丞相陆秀夫背起小皇帝跳海而死，许多官员和士兵也随之投海。
yamen.why: Yamen ended the Song dynasty. For the first time all of China came under the rule of a people from the steppe.
yamen.why_zh: 崖山之战标志着宋朝彻底灭亡，整个中国第一次被来自草原的民族统治。

story: Soon after conquering the south, Kublai ordered a new calendar to replace the inaccurate one inherited from the Jin. The work was led by Wang Xun and Guo Shoujing, a brilliant engineer and astronomer from Hebei. Guo designed new bronze instruments, including a simplified armillary sphere, and built a tall gnomon to measure the sun's shadow.

Observers were sent to 27 sites across the empire, from the South China Sea to Siberia, to measure the sky. The resulting Shoushi ('Granting the Seasons') calendar was issued in 1280 and used from 1281. It fixed the length of the year at 365.2425 days, the same value used by the Gregorian calendar that Europe adopted three centuries later.
story_zh: 征服南方后不久，忽必烈下令编制新历，以取代沿用自金朝、误差较大的旧历。这项工作由王恂和郭守敬主持。郭守敬是河北人，精通水利和天文，他设计了简仪等新的铜制仪器，还建造了高大的圭表来测量日影。
朝廷派人到全国二十七个地点进行观测，南到南海，北到西伯利亚。新编成的《授时历》于1280年颁布，次年起施行。它把一年定为365.2425日，与三百年后欧洲采用的格里高利历完全相同。
shoushi-calendar.why: The Shoushi calendar was the most accurate in the world at the time and, renamed, stayed in use through the whole Ming dynasty.
shoushi-calendar.why_zh: 《授时历》是当时世界上最精确的历法，后来改名后在整个明代继续使用。

story: Under the Yuan, the civil service exams were suspended for decades and many educated men lost the usual road to office. Some turned to writing for the theater. In Dadu and other cities, zaju, a form of drama with four acts in which one lead singer performs all the songs, became hugely popular.

The most famous playwright was Guan Hanqing, who wrote more than sixty plays. His best-known work, The Injustice to Dou E, tells of a young widow executed for a crime she did not commit, whose dying curses come true. Other leading writers included Ma Zhiyuan, Bai Pu and Wang Shifu, whose Romance of the Western Chamber is a love story still performed today. Plays used everyday language and featured ordinary people.
story_zh: 元朝有几十年没有举行科举，许多读书人失去了做官的正常途径，其中一些人转而为戏台写作。在大都和其他城市，杂剧大受欢迎。这种戏剧通常分为四折，全剧唱段由一个主角包办。
最著名的剧作家是关汉卿，他写了六十多部剧本。代表作《窦娥冤》讲述一个年轻寡妇蒙冤被斩，临刑前发下的誓愿一一应验。其他重要作家还有马致远、白朴和王实甫，王实甫的《西厢记》是一部至今仍在上演的爱情戏。杂剧使用口语，主人公常常是普通百姓。
yuan-zaju.why: Yuan zaju is counted as one of the great forms of Chinese literature, alongside Tang poetry and Song ci, and shaped all later Chinese opera.
yuan-zaju.why_zh: 元杂剧与唐诗、宋词并称，是中国文学的高峰之一，也深刻影响了后来的各种戏曲。

story: After his first attempt in 1274 failed, Kublai sent envoys demanding that Japan submit. The Kamakura shogunate, led by Hōjō Tokimune, executed them and built a stone wall along Hakata Bay. In 1281 Kublai sent two fleets: one from Korea with Mongol, Chinese and Korean troops, and a much larger one carrying former Song soldiers from south China.

The two forces met near Kyushu, but the Japanese wall and night raids on the ships kept them from landing in strength. In August a typhoon struck the crowded fleet. Most ships sank, and many of the soldiers left on shore were killed or captured. Kublai planned a third invasion but finally gave it up.
story_zh: 1274年第一次进攻失败后，忽必烈派使者要求日本臣服。由北条时宗主政的镰仓幕府斩杀使者，并沿博多湾修筑石墙。1281年，忽必烈派出两路大军：一路从高丽出发，由蒙古、汉人和高丽士兵组成；另一路规模更大，主要是南宋降兵，从江南出海。
两路大军在九州附近会合，但日军凭借石墙防守，又趁夜偷袭船队，元军始终无法大规模登陆。8月，一场台风袭击了密集停泊的船队，大部分船只沉没，留在岸上的士兵多被杀或被俘。忽必烈曾计划第三次出征，最后还是放弃了。
japan-invasion.why: The failure marked the limit of Mongol power at sea. In Japan the storm became the legend of the 'divine wind', or kamikaze.
japan-invasion.why_zh: 这次失败标志着蒙古军力在海上的极限。在日本，这场台风演变成了"神风"的传说。

story: Wen Tianxiang came first in the palace examination of 1256. When the Yuan armies invaded, he raised troops in Jiangxi and became chief minister in the last days of Lin'an. After escaping from Yuan detention he fought on in Fujian and Guangdong until he was captured in 1278.

The Yuan commander Zhang Hongfan took him by ship past Lingdingyang, where Wen wrote his famous poem, and made him watch the battle of Yamen. He was then held in a prison in Dadu for more than three years, where he wrote the 'Song of the Righteous Spirit'. Kublai himself offered him high office, but Wen asked only to die. He was executed in Dadu in January 1283, facing south toward the lost Song lands.
story_zh: 文天祥是1256年的状元。元军南下时，他在江西起兵勤王，临安危急时出任右丞相。从元营逃脱后，他在福建、广东一带继续抗元，1278年兵败被俘。
元将张弘范押着他乘船经过零丁洋，文天祥在这里写下了千古名篇，随后又被迫目睹了崖山之战。此后他被关押在大都狱中三年多，写出了《正气歌》。忽必烈亲自劝降，许以高官，文天祥只求一死。1283年1月，他在大都从容就义，临刑前向南方故国跪拜。
wen-tianxiang.why: Wen Tianxiang became the great Chinese symbol of loyalty that cannot be bought, and his poems are still learned by every schoolchild.
wen-tianxiang.why_zh: 文天祥成为中国人心中坚贞不屈的象征，他的诗句至今仍是学生必读的名篇。

quote.zh: 人生自古谁无死，留取丹心照汗青。
quote.en: Since ancient times who has not died? Let me leave a loyal heart to shine in the pages of history.
quote.from: Wen Tianxiang, Crossing Lingding Sea 文天祥《过零丁洋》

story: Dadu needed huge amounts of grain from the Yangtze delta. The old Grand Canal of the Sui and Song ran west through Kaifeng, a long detour. The Yuan built new sections through Shandong, the Jizhou canal in 1283 and the Huitong canal in 1289, making the route almost straight from Hangzhou to the north. But the last stretch into the capital was still a problem.

Guo Shoujing found new water sources in the hills west of Dadu and led them into the city through a channel with a series of locks. Work began in 1292 and finished in 1293. When Kublai returned from Shangdu and saw the lake inside the city crowded with grain ships, he named the canal Tonghui, 'Bringing Benefit'.
story_zh: 大都需要从长江三角洲运来大量粮食。隋唐和宋代的大运河向西绕经开封，路途遥远。元朝在山东境内新开了济州河（1283年）和会通河（1289年），使运河从杭州到北方几乎成了一条直线。但从通州进入大都城的最后一段，仍然是个难题。
郭守敬在大都西面的山中找到了新的水源，开渠引水入城，沿途修建一系列水闸。工程1292年动工，1293年完工。忽必烈从上都回来，看到城中积水潭里停满了漕船，十分高兴，赐名"通惠河"。
tonghui-river.why: The straightened Grand Canal ran roughly along the route still used today and fed Beijing for the next six centuries.
tonghui-river.why_zh: 取直后的京杭大运河大致就是今天的走向，此后六百年间一直是北京的粮食命脉。

story: Huang Daopo was born into a poor family in Wunijing, near Songjiang in today's Shanghai. According to tradition she ran away as a young woman and reached Yazhou on Hainan Island, where she lived for about thirty years and learned the cotton skills of the local Li people.

Around 1295 she came home. She taught her neighbors to use a roller gin to remove seeds, a large bow to fluff the cotton, a treadle spinning wheel with three spindles, and new ways to weave patterned cloth. Songjiang soon became the cotton center of China, and its cloth was said to 'clothe the whole empire'. After her death local people built a shrine to her.
story_zh: 黄道婆出生在松江乌泥泾（今属上海）一个贫苦人家。相传她年轻时离家出走，流落到海南岛的崖州，在那里生活了约三十年，向当地黎族人学会了棉纺织技术。
大约1295年，她回到家乡，教乡亲们用搅车轧去棉籽，用大弓弹松棉花，用三锭脚踏纺车纺纱，还传授了织出花纹布的方法。松江很快成为全国的棉纺织中心，有"衣被天下"之称。她去世后，乡人为她立祠纪念。
huang-daopo.why: Her story marks the spread of cotton as the everyday cloth of ordinary Chinese people, replacing hemp.
huang-daopo.why_zh: 黄道婆的故事反映了棉布逐渐取代麻布，成为中国普通百姓日常衣料的过程。

story: For more than forty years the Yuan held no civil service exams. Officials were chosen by birth, by recommendation and from the clerks. Ayurbarwada, who became Emperor Renzong in 1311, had been educated by Confucian teachers and wanted to bring scholars into government.

In 1313 he decreed that the exams would be restored, and the first metropolitan exam was held in 1315. Questions were based on the Four Books with Zhu Xi's commentaries. Candidates were divided into two lists: Mongols and Semu (Central and West Asians) took easier papers, while Han Chinese and southerners took harder ones. Each list had the same quota, so the system favored the smaller groups. At most 100 men won the highest degree each time.
story_zh: 元朝有四十多年没有举行科举，官员主要靠出身、举荐和吏员升迁产生。1311年即位的元仁宗爱育黎拔力八达自幼受儒学教育，希望让读书人进入朝廷。
1313年，他下诏恢复科举，1315年举行了第一次会试。考题以四书为主，以朱熹的注释为准。考生分为两榜：蒙古人、色目人考题较易，汉人、南人考题较难，两榜录取名额相同，因此对人数较少的群体更为有利。每次录取的进士最多不过一百名。
yuan-exams.why: Though small, the Yuan exams made Zhu Xi's teachings the official standard, which lasted until the exams were abolished in 1905.
yuan-exams.why_zh: 元代科举规模虽小，却把朱熹的学说定为官方标准，这一规定一直延续到1905年废除科举。

people.name: Emperor Renzong of Yuan
people.role_zh: 元朝皇帝（爱育黎拔力八达）

story: Emperor Yesün Temür died at Shangdu in August 1328. His officials there put his young son Ragibagh on the throne. But in Dadu, the powerful Kipchak general El Temür seized control and declared for Tugh Temür, a son of an earlier emperor, Khayishan.

Armies loyal to the two capitals fought each other around the passes north of Dadu for about two months. El Temür won, and Shangdu surrendered; Ragibagh disappeared. Tugh Temür then offered the throne to his elder brother Khoshila, who came from Central Asia. Khoshila died suddenly a few days after meeting his brother in 1329, probably poisoned, and Tugh Temür took the throne again. El Temür held real power at court until his death.
story_zh: 1328年8月，元泰定帝也孙铁木儿死于上都，上都的大臣拥立他年幼的儿子阿剌吉八即位。与此同时，钦察人出身的权臣燕铁木儿在大都发动政变，拥立元武宗的儿子图帖睦尔。
两都军队交战约两个月，最后燕铁木儿获胜，上都投降，阿剌吉八下落不明。图帖睦尔随即表示把皇位让给从中亚赶回的哥哥和世㻋。1329年，和世㻋与弟弟会面后几天就暴死，很可能是被毒杀，图帖睦尔重新登基，即元文宗。此后燕铁木儿一直把持朝政，直到去世。
two-capitals-war.why: The war showed how unstable the Yuan succession had become. Between 1307 and 1333 eight emperors reigned, and the court never recovered its strength.
two-capitals-war.why_zh: 两都之战说明元朝的皇位继承已经极不稳定。1307年至1333年间先后换了八位皇帝，朝廷再也没有恢复元气。

story: It was a tradition for each dynasty to write the official history of the one before it. The Yuan had conquered three states, the Liao, the Jin and the Song, but for decades scholars argued over which of them was the 'legitimate' dynasty. The argument blocked the work.

In 1343 the chief minister Toghto settled the question: each of the three would get its own history, with equal status. He led a team of Mongol, Semu and Han scholars. The History of Liao and the History of Jin were finished in 1344, and the History of Song in 1345. With 496 chapters, the History of Song is the longest of the official dynastic histories. It was written fast and has many errors and repetitions.
story_zh: 按照传统，每个朝代都要为前朝修一部正史。元朝先后灭了辽、金、宋三国，但学者们几十年来一直争论三者之中谁才是"正统"，修史工作因此迟迟无法开展。
1343年，丞相脱脱拍板：三国"各与正统"，各修一史，地位平等。他主持编修，团队里有蒙古、色目和汉人学者。《辽史》《金史》于1344年完成，《宋史》于1345年完成。《宋史》共四百九十六卷，是二十四史中篇幅最大的一部。由于成书仓促，书中错漏重复之处也不少。
three-histories.why: The three histories preserve much of what we know about these dynasties. Treating them as equals was a new way of thinking about Chinese history.
three-histories.why_zh: 这三部正史保存了有关这几个朝代的大量史料。把三朝平等对待，也是看待中国历史的一种新思路。

story: Huang Gongwang was a scholar from Changshu who had served as a minor clerk, was briefly jailed, and then became a Daoist and painter. He spent his later years around the Fuchun River near Hangzhou. In 1347, when he was in his late seventies, he began a long handscroll for a Daoist friend, Wuyong.

He worked on it off and on for several years and finished it around 1350. The scroll, more than six meters long, shows the hills, trees and villages along the river in soft, dry ink strokes. In 1650 a later owner, who loved it dearly, tried to burn it so it would go with him to his death. His nephew pulled it from the fire, but it was split in two.
story_zh: 黄公望是常熟人，早年做过小吏，曾短暂入狱，后来入道，以绘画为业。他晚年常住在杭州附近的富春江一带。1347年，年近八十的他开始为道友无用师画一幅长卷。
他断断续续画了好几年，约在1350年完成。画卷长六米多，用干淡的笔墨描绘江边的山峦、树木和村落。1650年，一位极爱此画的收藏者临终前要把它烧掉殉葬，他的侄子从火中抢出，但画已被烧成两段。
fuchun-mountains.why: Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains became a model for later Chinese landscape painters. Its two parts, in Hangzhou and Taipei, were shown together in 2011.
fuchun-mountains.why_zh: 《富春山居图》成为后世山水画家学习的典范。分藏于杭州和台北的两段画卷于2011年首次合璧展出。

story: By the mid-1300s the Yuan was weakened by court struggles, inflation of its paper money and natural disasters. In 1344 the Yellow River broke its banks and flooded large parts of Shandong and Henan. In 1351 the chief minister Toghto ordered the engineer Jia Lu to repair the river and put about 150,000 laborers to work.

Secret religious groups had long spread the belief that the future Buddha Maitreya would soon come down to the world. Han Shantong and Liu Futong, leaders of such a group, planned a revolt. Han was caught and killed, but Liu rose at Yingzhou. His followers wore red headbands. The revolt spread quickly across the Huai region, and other rebel armies rose in the Yangtze valley.
story_zh: 到14世纪中叶，元朝因宫廷内斗、纸币贬值和天灾而日益衰落。1344年黄河决口，山东、河南大片地区被淹。1351年，丞相脱脱任命贾鲁治理黄河，征发了约十五万民夫。
民间秘密宗教长期宣扬"弥勒降生"，说未来佛即将下凡拯救世人。韩山童、刘福通等人借此密谋起事。韩山童事泄被杀，刘福通在颍州起兵，部众头裹红巾，称为红巾军。起义迅速蔓延到江淮各地，长江流域也有多支起义军响应。
red-turbans.why: The Red Turban revolts broke Yuan control over the south and produced the leader who would found the Ming, Zhu Yuanzhang.
red-turbans.why_zh: 红巾军起义瓦解了元朝在南方的统治，也造就了后来建立明朝的朱元璋。

story: Zhu Yuanzhang was born in 1328 into a poor tenant family near Haozhou. In 1344 drought, locusts and disease killed his parents and elder brother within weeks. With no money for coffins, he buried them in borrowed ground. He then entered the Huangjue Temple as a novice monk, and when the temple ran out of food he wandered the Huai region for three years as a begging monk.

In 1352 a childhood friend wrote to him from the army of Guo Zixing, a Red Turban leader who held Haozhou. Zhu joined. He proved brave and capable, and Guo gave him his adopted daughter, Miss Ma, as a wife. Zhu soon began to recruit his own men, including Xu Da, later his greatest general.
story_zh: 朱元璋1328年出生在濠州一个贫苦佃农家里。1344年，旱灾、蝗灾和瘟疫接连而来，几周之内他的父母和大哥相继去世，家里连棺材都买不起，只能借地安葬。他随后进入皇觉寺当了小和尚，寺里断粮后，又在淮河一带化缘流浪了三年。
1352年，一位儿时伙伴从占据濠州的红巾军首领郭子兴军中给他写信，朱元璋便去投军。他作战勇敢，办事干练，郭子兴把养女马氏许配给他。不久，朱元璋开始招募自己的人马，其中就有后来成为他头号大将的徐达。
zhu-joins-guo.why: The orphan and beggar monk began here the rise that would make him the founder of the Ming dynasty.
zhu-joins-guo.why_zh: 这个孤儿出身的游方僧，从这里开始了他成为明朝开国皇帝的历程。

story: After Guo Zixing died in 1355, Zhu Yuanzhang gradually took over his army. He crossed the Yangtze that year and in 1356 captured Jiqing, the Yuan name for Nanjing, a rich city with strong natural defenses. He renamed it Yingtian, 'Answering Heaven', and made it his capital.

Zhu still served nominally under the Red Turban 'Song' state of Han Lin'er. He followed the advice of the scholar Zhu Sheng to build strong walls, store up grain and not rush to call himself king. He brought in capable advisers such as Li Shanchang and later Liu Ji, kept his soldiers from looting and set up farming colonies for the army. In 1364 he finally took the title King of Wu.
story_zh: 1355年郭子兴去世后，朱元璋逐步接管了他的部队。他在当年渡过长江，1356年攻下集庆（元朝对南京的称呼）。这是一座富庶的城市，又有天然的险要地势。他把集庆改名为应天府，以此作为大本营。
当时朱元璋名义上仍奉韩林儿的红巾军"宋"政权为正朔。他采纳儒士朱升的建议，修筑城墙，囤积粮食，不急于称王。他招揽李善长、后来又有刘基等有才干的谋士，严禁士兵抢掠，推行军屯。直到1364年，他才自称吴王。
zhu-takes-nanjing.why: Nanjing gave Zhu a rich, secure base in the Yangtze delta. It became the first capital of the Ming dynasty.
zhu-takes-nanjing.why_zh: 南京为朱元璋提供了长江下游一个富庶而稳固的根据地，后来成为明朝的第一个都城。

quote.en: Build high walls, store up grain, and be slow to call yourself king.
quote.from: Zhu Sheng's advice, History of Ming 明史·朱升传

story: By 1363 two rebel leaders were competing for the Yangtze valley: Zhu Yuanzhang at Nanjing and Chen Youliang, who ruled the middle Yangtze as emperor of Han. Chen built a fleet of huge tower ships and besieged Nanchang, but Zhu's nephew Zhu Wenzheng held the city for 85 days.

Zhu Yuanzhang came to the rescue with a fleet of smaller, faster boats, and the two navies fought on Lake Poyang for more than a month. Chen's big ships were hard to steer in the shallows. On a day with a favorable wind Zhu sent fire ships into Chen's tied-up fleet and burned much of it. Trapped on the lake and short of food, Chen tried to break out and was killed by an arrow.
story_zh: 到1363年，长江流域剩下两位最强的起义军首领：据守南京的朱元璋，和在长江中游称帝、国号为汉的陈友谅。陈友谅造了一批巨大的楼船，围攻洪都（今南昌），朱元璋的侄子朱文正死守了八十五天。
朱元璋率领小而灵活的船队前来解围，双方在鄱阳湖上激战一个多月。陈友谅的大船在浅水中转动不便。一天顺风，朱元璋派火船冲入陈军连在一起的船阵，烧毁大批战船。陈友谅被困湖中，粮草断绝，突围时中箭身亡。
poyang.why: The victory made Zhu Yuanzhang the strongest power in the south and opened his path to founding the Ming.
poyang.why_zh: 这场胜利使朱元璋成为南方最强大的势力，为他建立明朝铺平了道路。

people.name: Zhu Yuanzhang
people.role_zh: 起义军首领，后来的明太祖

people.name: Chen Youliang
people.role: Rival rebel leader, emperor of Han

story: Zhang Shicheng was a salt boatman from northern Jiangsu who rebelled in 1353. In 1354 he survived a huge Yuan siege of Gaoyou when the court suddenly dismissed its commander, Toghto. In 1356 he took Pingjiang (Suzhou) and ruled the rich lands around Lake Tai, at times accepting Yuan titles. In 1363 he called himself King of Wu.

After defeating Chen Youliang, Zhu Yuanzhang turned on Zhang. His generals Xu Da and Chang Yuchun first took Zhang's lands north of the Yangtze and in Zhejiang, then surrounded Suzhou in late 1366. The siege lasted ten months. In October 1367 the city fell. Zhang was taken to Nanjing, where he hanged himself. Zhu then sent his armies north against the Yuan.
story_zh: 张士诚是苏北的盐贩船夫，1353年起兵反元。1354年，元朝丞相脱脱率大军围攻高邮，眼看城破，朝廷却突然罢免了脱脱，张士诚因此转危为安。1356年，他占据平江（今苏州），控制了太湖周边的富庶地区，有时还接受元朝的封号。1363年他自称吴王。
朱元璋击败陈友谅后，掉头对付张士诚。徐达、常遇春先攻取张士诚在江北和浙江的地盘，1366年底包围平江，围城长达十个月。1367年10月，平江城破，张士诚被押到南京后自缢而死。朱元璋随即挥师北伐元朝。
pingjiang.why: With his last rival in the south gone, Zhu was free to found the Ming early in 1368 and drive the Yuan from Dadu.
pingjiang.why_zh: 南方最后的对手被消灭后，朱元璋得以在1368年初建立明朝，并把元朝赶出大都。
